1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the method is executed on a computing device that is configured to process the unique identifier and generate the at least use information.

25. (Currently Amended) A user device for providing information regarding a product, the user device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing the product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the user device further configured to communicate with a data store, the data store storing the user information regarding past use of the product in association with the unique identifier, and wherein the user device includes a processor that executes software instructions to perform the generating and communicating functions.

26. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the computing device further configured to communicate with a network, and wherein the computing device includes a processor for executing stored instructions that implement the receiving and generating functions. 

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user, wherein the reading is performed by a user device configured to access user information associated with the second unique identifier.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the specific role of the user, wherein the role of the user includes a caregiver role or a patient role based on stored user information associated with the unique identifier. 

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for the user based on characteristics of the user stored in a user profile. 

27. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, wherein the device further comprises a processor that enables the execution of software instructions implementing the method steps.
